key_findings: 15.7% of 572 migraine patients were ultra-late responders to anti-CGRP mAbs (response only after 24 weeks); only 8.7% did not respond within 48 weeks.
Ultra-late responders had higher BMI, longer medication overuse, more comorbidities and less unilateral pain than responders.
